headline: Strong cash flow and buybacks, Twin Eagle deal closed
summary_short: Expand Energy earned $2.24 per diluted share ($1.46 adjusted) on net production of 7.54 Bcfe/d, with operating cash flow of $1,177M. It repurchased $305M of stock and closed the Twin Eagle acquisition.
summary_long: Adjusted EBITDAX was $1,229M. Production was 92% natural gas, including 6.9 Bcf/d gas, 17 MBbls/d oil and 87 MBbls/d NGLs. Total debt was $4.6B with 0.8x leverage. Year-to-date buybacks are about $900M, roughly 4% of shares, with $1B of authorization remaining. Marketing adjusted EBITDA was $150M for nine months, with $80M expected in Q4. 2026 outlook: capex about $3B and production of 7.45-7.55 Bcfe/d on 11-12 rigs. Base dividend is $0.575 per share.
confidence_notes: The release states no prior-period comparisons in its text, so no deltas are shown. Adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDAX are non-GAAP measures reconciled in the release.

drivers.explanation: Driven by operational performance and liquids revenue, per the release.
CEO emphasizes scale, an investment-grade balance sheet and coast-to-coast customer access to monetize gas market volatility and expected demand growth.
